items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: The other orchestra was a pick-up band under the leadership of Loon Cross known by all the Rhythm Club fellows as Boss Man.

ctx.x: After some dates in a few other Southern cities, we played a night at the Golden Gate Ballroom in the Apple. Buddy Miller was not there when started the night. The other orchestra was a pick-up band under the leadership of Loon Cross known by all the Rhythm Club fellows as Boss Man. Loon had an alto man with him that I didn't know and Andy asked him if he would play a set with the band until Buddy came.

Buddy played most of the first alto part and this fellow was reading them as though he had been playing them for years. When Buddy did show up, he was too drunk to play. Andy asked Boss Man's alto player if he would finish the night with the band and he accepted. Andy fired Buddy then and there and when the night was finished, the other fellow accepted to stay with the band. His name was Ben Smith, and he and I became quite good friends.
